# Florian Molea

> Florian Molea is a Romanian driving instructor for Categoria B in Bucuresti. The website helps visitors book lessons through WhatsApp, discover long-form YouTube exam-route videos, and find Florian's official social media channels.

## Primary Actions

- Watch full exam-route lessons on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@florianmolea

- Homepage: /

## Website Focus

The website is a one-page Romanian landing page for Florian Molea, Instructor Auto Categoria B. It emphasizes clear driving explanations, calm instruction, real traffic practice in Bucuresti, and an active online community.

The strongest content focus is YouTube, where visitors can watch long videos with complete exam routes, real traffic situations, and calm step-by-step explanations.
